description.value:
武器（任意弹药），非普通

使用这种弹药发动的远程武器攻击可以无视 半身掩护half cover 与 四分之三掩护three-quarters cover。

此外，使用这种弹药发动的远程武器攻击不会因以最大射程攻击而具有劣势。

Ranged weapon attack rolls made with this ammunition ignore half and &Reference[rule=Cover]{three-quarters cover}. In addition, attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls made with this ammunition.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Arrow|PHB] (@item[Winged Arrow|BMT])
  • @item[Blowgun Needle|PHB] (@item[Winged Blowgun Needle|BMT])
  • @item[Crossbow Bolt|PHB] (@item[Winged Crossbow Bolt|BMT])
  • @item[Modern Bullet|DMG] (@item[Winged Modern Bullet|BMT])
  • @item[Renaissance Bullet|DMG] (@item[Winged Renaissance Bullet|BMT])
  • @item[Sling Bullet|PHB] (@item[Winged Sling Bullet|BMT])
